_comment: Instruction/memory models fitted ONLY on same-direction RDM cells.
Why: every *_rew_instr model relabels a backward condition with its
forward vector, so it forces dissimilarity 0 on exactly the same-task
forward/backward pairs. But the instruction screen is not identical for
the two directions -- it carries a 'please backwards' text, or nothing,
implying forwards. Those forced-zero cells are the only 0 level in the
model, they carry the whole low-end leverage, and they are precisely
where the stimulus differs. No nuisance regressor can absorb them:
anything correlated enough with the instruction model to move its
coefficient IS the model's own main contrast. Scope
'within_same_direction' removes the confound by design instead.
Cost: the d = 0 level disappears, 40 of 90 within-half cells remain, and
those 40 are 20 task-pair comparisons each measured twice (once F-F,
once B-B) with an identical model value -- so 20 independent predictions
per subject, and a free split-half reliability check.
No execution/planning models here: they are unaffected by the direction
cue and are already fitted by rsa_instruction_cumulative_rew.json.
The searchlight data-RDM cache is keyed on regression_version + TR +
searchlight_mask, NOT on name_of_RSA, so this run reuses the existing
data_RDMs_glmbase_01-TR4_grey_matter cache and recomputes no searchlights.
Results land in RSA_instr_cumrew_samedir_glmbase_01-TR4/ and every map
carries a _within-samedir suffix, so nothing collides with earlier runs.
